english: An information session on recruiting outgoing exchange students for the 2nd semester of the 2027 academic year will be held. Interested students are encouraged to attend.
1. Date and time: 30 Oct 2026 (Fri), morning 10:00 - 11:30 / afternoon 14:00 - 15:30
* The same session is held twice, once in the morning and once in the afternoon.
2. Venue: Seminar Room, 1st floor, Building 152 (CJ International Center)
3. Main content: General information about exchange semesters abroad (studying at a partner university overseas)
4. Who can attend: Undergraduate and graduate students interested in studying at a foreign university as an exchange student
6. Contact: 이혁주 (Lee Hyeok-ju), staff officer, 국제처 (Office of Global Affairs) (☎ 02-880-2594)
